acceptanceCriteria: Automated tests cover deterministic core behavior and critical UI flows.
Device checks cover audio quality, interruptions, route changes, hearing-safe defaults, and Watch behavior.
App Store privacy, accessibility, icon, screenshots, metadata, and archive requirements are reviewed.
No accidental JustTune name, identifier, asset, or metadata remains.
rationale: Audio and naming mistakes are user-impacting and App Store readiness requires device-level evidence.
testSteps: Run the complete test suite and archive validation with the current official Xcode before submission.

workItem.title: Qualify and prepare JustTones 1.0 for the App Store
